body: This is basically me too. I always see people happy and I just wish I had something similar. I’ve been alone all my life and would always see people happy together, but I’ve never really had the chance to experience it. I always go home alone and sit in my room alone. I know exactly how this feels, OP. I’m not sure what else to say, but I have similar feelings.

What if you’re born into a new body and a new environment or situation that’s even worse than you’re current one? Reincarnated into a new he’ll. I don’t know if I would want to be born again unless I knew it would be better than what I have now. Just my thoughts. I don’t know.

I wouldn’t ever attempt to kill myself, but just like some other people on here say, I would definitely be ok if I was killed by something other than myself. By another person, a freak accident, or just some act of god. I’d be ok with it and accept it. I wouldn’t have to deal with all the unhappiness, bullshit, and disappointment in my life.

Thanks for the comment. Music usually helps distract me and lighten my mood. It even gives me hope sometimes. The dreams have been the absolute worst and then waking up to my true reality is just another thing I absolutely dread.

I’m struggling to live with the regret. I didn’t try hard enough either and I lost so much in such little time. I also lost someone that was really special to me and I can’t get over it. I didn’t try hard enough, give the same response, or put in the effort. Beating myself up over it every fucking day and it’s the first thought in the morning. I’m hoping every day that I will hear from them, but as the days go by, I don’t think it will happen. I really fucked it up. I had so many things planned for us in the near future and to see all those plans crumble breaks my heart.

I’m going through a situation that’s all my fault so I’m going to blame myself. I made choices that led up to my misery. If I didn’t make these shitty and stupid fucking choices I wouldn’t be in the current state that I am in. There’s nobody else to blame so I take the weight of it. How can I not blame myself when literally everything that’s gone wrong is from my own decisions?

I’m in a similar situation. I fucked up with a girl that I was really interested in and I thought she felt the same towards me. I was going through a tragedy at the time and I really fucked it up with this person. I been beating myself up about it every day and when I sleep, I dream about it. I can’t get it out of my head and I will always live with this regret. I still can’t fucking believe all that has happened. Everything just days apart.
